components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident, minimal. Warm teal background, moonlight text. 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand, #009084); color: var(--text-primary, #e9f0ef); padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: -0.005em; transition: background 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #00a89a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00a89a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with border, subtle background on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(9, 19, 17, 0.6); color: var(--text-secondary, #bdc6c5); padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--border-standard, #1a2422); cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: -0.005em; transition: all 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(17, 28, 26, 0.8); color: var(--text-primary, #e9f0ef); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00a89a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Monospace label for technology stacks. Functional, not decorative.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 400; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(9, 19, 17, 0.8); color: var(--text-tertiary, #798381); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #101817); letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Bento grid card. First card spans 2 columns. Accent border on hover.
components.html:
Visitech IIoT Dashboard

ReactDocker

Real-time monitoring dashboard.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(9, 19, 17, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-standard, #1a2422); border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #00a89a); background: var(--surface-hover, #111c1a); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: var(--sans, 'Outfit', sans-serif); font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #e9f0ef); margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-secondary, #bdc6c5); flex: 1; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky, translucent, minimal. Full-width with backdrop blur.
components.html:
Kyryll Nehaturov
ProjectsExperienceSkillsContact
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px clamp(24px, 5vw, 80px); background: rgba(3, 7, 6, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #101817); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: var(--sans, 'Outfit', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #e9f0ef); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: var(--sans, 'Outfit', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-tertiary, #798381); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #e9f0ef); }

components.name: Available for Hire Pill
components.description: Inline pill with pulsing green dot. Width: fit-content to prevent stretching in full-width layout.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--brand, #009084); background: rgba(0, 144, 132, 0.08); font-family: var(--sans, 'Outfit', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--accent, #00a89a); width: fit-content; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #00ac5f); animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

narrative.overview: This is a portfolio for someone who builds systems that run themselves. The design should feel like the systems it describes: alive, connected, self-sufficient. A generative particle canvas fills the hero, reacting to the cursor like an agent orchestration graph. The layout is radical and full-bleed. No centered-column safety net. The headline fills the screen at clamp(3rem, 9vw, 7rem). Projects use a bento grid where the strongest work spans two columns.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed layout with fluid edge padding (clamp(24px, 5vw, 80px))
Generative particle canvas as hero background (Canvas 2D, cursor-reactive)
Typewriter headline animation with blinking caret
Warm teal monochrome palette with dual-theme (dark/light) support
Massive display typography that fills the viewport width
Bento grid for project cards (asymmetric, not uniform)

rules.name: The No Pure Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Never use #000 or #fff. Every neutral is tinted toward the brand hue at chroma 0.005-0.01.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm teal is the only saturated color. Its rarity on the page is what makes it powerful.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Rule
rules.body: Light mode is NOT inverted dark mode. Different surface hierarchies, accent lightness, and border treatment.

rules.name: The Massive Display Rule
rules.body: The hero headline uses clamp(3rem, 9vw, 7rem). It should feel like it owns the viewport.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for data labels. Never for body text, headings, or navigation.

rules.name: The No Flat Scale Rule
rules.body: Each type scale step is a clear visual jump, not a subtle nudge.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No shadows, no glassmorphism, no decorative blurs.

rules.name: The Border-as-Depth Rule
rules.body: Borders replace shadows for surface definition. Three-step scale: subtle, standard, solid.

dos: Do use warm teal (#009084) as the only saturated accent.
Do tint every neutral toward the brand hue.
Do let the hero headline fill the viewport.
Do use the bento grid for projects.
Do use width: fit-content on inline pills and tags.
Do use --page-px for all edge padding.
donts: Don't use modals as first thought.
Don't wrap everything in a container.
Don't use monospace for body text or headings.
